thread:
Nina: Heads-up, PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/895 updates SDK snippets. Auto-merge hung because branch protection lists `ci/full` as required but that workflow is configured to skip on docs-only. Anyone know the safe quick-unblock?
Ethan: We ran into this across multiple repos. Two safe options: 1) change branch protection for docs repo to accept `docs/preview` instead of `ci/full`, or 2) have infra emit a harmless success status for `ci/full` when the run is intentionally skipped.
label-bot: "label-bot added: docs"
Nina: label added but auto-merge already evaluated, so no help retroactively.
devops-bot: "devops-bot: ci/full skipped (docs-only). To satisfy branch protection, please request manual override or contact eng-infra."
Ethan: Manual path: add `docs:manual-merge` label + one owner approval and merge-bot will do manual override. Quickest for the release demo.
Nina: I added `docs:manual-merge`. @Ethan can you approve?
Ethan: approved. merge-bot: please go.
merge-bot: "merge-bot: Manual override applied. PR #895 merged into main."
Nina: Filing a tiny RFC to let auto-merge consult `.github/auto-merge.yml` so docs repos can require `docs/preview` and treat `ci/full` as optional. Will loop in eng-infra.
Ethan: SGTM. Also recommend we avoid creating fake `ci/full` statuses unless infra explicitly signs off.
